title: Grant
description: Claims of an agent grant: a short-lived JWT access token (RFC 9068, header typ at+jwt) the STS issues under a mandate, bound to the agent's key. For a user mandate, sub is the user and the grant names the consent it rests on, so the resource sees the user as if they had called; for a service mandate the agent is its own sub, so sub equals client_id.

iss.description: The STS that issued the grant.

sub.description: Whom the agent acts for: the user, unique across every identity provider the box trusts, or, under a service mandate, the agent itself.

sub_id.description: Where the user's identity came from. Present exactly when sub is a user, that is, when sub differs from client_id.

aud.description: Resource servers that accept the grant: exactly the locations of authorization_details.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the grant was issued to: the agent, as the identity it authenticated with names it, or its agent name for a registration identity (RFC 9068).

cnf.description: The DPoP key the grant is bound to (RFC 9449 §6.1). Every grant from the box's own STS carries one; it is optional here only for clients that cannot hold a key, such as hosted agents run by a vendor.

jkt.description: JWK SHA-256 thumbprint of the key (RFC 7638), base64url.

mandate.description: The mandate the grant was issued under.

consent.description: The consent the grant rests on. Present exactly when sub is a user.

authorization_details.description: What the grant allows: the mandate's permissions intersected with the agent's.

limits.description: Budgets this grant draws from. A per-day or per-month budget is shared by every grant of the same consent.

status.description: Where to check revocation (Token Status List).
